snippet.title: Changing my indie game's name saved the entire project! (Just Madness)
snippet.description:
Picking the wrong name for your indie game can completely destroy your reach in the algorithm or lead to serious legal issues. In this video, I explain why I officially changed the name from Max Madness to Just Madness: Earth Apocalypse 1979, how trademark and unfair competition laws impact indie developers, and why this shift will save the game on Steam. If you are a solo dev or a fan of post-apocalyptic games, make sure to follow along!

Wishlist Just Madness on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3652470/Just_Madness_Earth_Apocalypse_1979/
